reset_password.title: Reset your password
reset_password.contents: Click the button below to create a new password for your account:
reset_password.footer: The link expires after 1 hour. If you did not request a password reset, please ignore this email.

driver_document_expiring.title: Document expiring soon
driver_document_expiring.action_required: Please renew the document as soon as possible.
driver_document_expiring.footer: Ignoring this warning may result in work restrictions.

driver_document_expired.title: Document expired - action required
driver_document_expired.consequence: Your account may be restricted until renewal.

push_enabled.title: Push Notifications Enabled
push_enabled.body: You have successfully enabled push notifications for this device.

template_notification.title: Template Notification
template_notification.body: This is a template notification with custom data: {customField}

early_settlement_requested.title: New Early Settlement Request
early_settlement_requested.body: Driver {driverName} has requested an early settlement of {requestedAmount} PLN.
early_settlement_requested.action_required: Please review the request in the admin panel.

early_settlement_info.title: Early Settlement Status: {status}
early_settlement_info.body: Your early settlement request for {requestedAmount} PLN has been {status}.
early_settlement_info.footer: If you have any questions, please contact the fleet administrator.
